senses.gloss: (cmp. גַּב) [to have a crust,] to be dry.
units: Ab. Zar. V, 3 (69ᵃ) כדי שישתום … ויִגּוֹב as much time as would be required for a person to bore a hole (uncork), and close it up, and (for the sealing clay) to get dry; ib. כדי שיפתח (את החבית) … ותִיגּוֹב to open the jug and close it up again, and (for the clay) to dry; a. e.—Part. pass. נָגוּב; f. נְגוּבָה; pl. נְגוּבִים, נְגוּבִין; נְגוּבוֹת dry.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 3:3">Ḥag. III, 3</cite> <he>אוכלים נ׳</he> dry eatables (which have not come in contact with liquids and are, therefore, insusceptible of levitical uncleanness, v. <cite ref="E00526"><he>הֶכְשֵׁר</he></cite>); <cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 3:11">Tosef. ib. III, 11</cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 3:12">Ib. 12</cite> <he>וכי יש נגובים לקדש</he> are the exemptions in favor of dry objects applicable to sacred matter?; <cite ref="Chagigah 24b:8">Ḥag. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>וכי יש נגובה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="N00151"><he>נְגִיבָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Chagigah 24a">Ib.ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>יד נ׳ מטמאה וכ׳</he> one dry hand (which has become unclean) makes the other hand unclean; a. e.

senses.gloss: to dry, wipe, scour. Ib. III, 1 (20ᵇ) מתיר ומְנַגֵּב ומטביל (Bab. ed. ומַנְגִּיב, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 3; Y. ed. מתיר ומטביל) he must open (the knots of the garment) and wipe it dry and smooth and then immerse.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28">Lev. R. s. 28</cite>, beg. <he>עד שלא יְנַגְּבָהּ</he> before he gets it (the garment) dry and glossy; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:3">ib.</cite> <he>ומְנַגֵּב את הארץ</he> and makes the earth dry; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:3">Koh. R. to I, 3</cite> <he>ומכבסן ומבשלן ומְנַגְּבָן</he> and washes them (the plants) and ripens and glosses them.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 5:11">Ab. Zar. V, 11</cite> <he>מְנַגְּבָהּ</he> he scours it; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 74b:9">ib. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>במה מְנַגְּבָן וכ׳</he> wherewith does he scour them? … with ashes, … with water.
Ib. 75ᵃ; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְנוּגָּב dry, parched, sapless, bare of.

<cite ref="Temurah 16a:46">Tem. 16ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>הנגב</he> <cite ref="Joshua 15:19">Josh. XV, 19</cite>) <he>בית שמנ׳ מכל וכ׳</he> a household bare of all that is good; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 27">Yalk. Josh. 27</cite> <he>אדם המנ׳ וכ׳</he> a man bare &c.

senses.gloss: same, v. supra.—2) (denom. of נֶגֶב) to go south.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 53b">Erub. 53ᵇ</cite> (in an enigmatic speech) <he>וה׳ למפיבשת</he> and went south to the great scholar (v. <cite ref="M02211"><he>מְפִיבשֶׁת</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: to be dried up. Sifra B’ḥuck. ch. I ונִתְנַגְּבָה הארץ the ground was dried up; Lev. R. s. 35.
